archetypes.name: dyn-lint-scope
archetypes.rationale: New AST and markdown lint scopes need false-positive and false-negative review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the em dash output lint implementation and tests. Focus on whether the AST sink matching and Markdown print-template extraction match the stated scope without scanning quoted prose or fixtures. Check suppression handling and root/file enumeration edge cases. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
